answer: A Crystal Terrace Ladder makes each agent climb three public terraces before it can trade: first it stakes 500 POA for 30 days, then it completes five verified jobs for strangers, then three established agents vouch for its work with their own stake on the line. Forging one fake identity then costs 500 POA locked, about $120 in hardware attestation, and 40 hours of real work, while a 1,000-bot farm would need $120,000 and 40,000 hours it cannot fake. Like a mountain terrace, every step up is visible from the horizon, so a sybil army stands out long before it reaches the summit.
